canonical_project: Firmus GEE01 / Long Reach Data Centre (Bell Bay)
notes: 'AI factory' campus proposed at Lot 1 East Tamar Highway, Long Reach, Bell Bay (former Gunns pulp mill site): two purpose-built AI data halls plus office and maintenance workshop; ~288MW draw with direct-to-chip liquid cooling; three 220kV TasNetworks transmission lines cross the site. Development application lodged with George Town Council (June 2026); community consultation extended after backlash; DA requests ~19.2 ML/yr water from TasWater. Status: DA under assessment - planned (grade B). Capacity basis: campus draw, not IT load.
